welcome.text: Welcome home! There is a whole little world to build.

move.text: Move with the round stick. Drag the sky to look around.

home.text: This is your house. Come inside!

door.text: Tap the door picture to open your door.

craft.text: Choose a picture. What shall we make?

made.text: You made it! Now find a lovely spot for it.

build.text: Choose a block, look at a clear space, and tap plus.

placed.text: A new piece for your world!

undo.text: You can undo your last building step.

hint.text: Would you like to build a little garden wall?

gather.text: Look for something special on our walk.

tryAgain.text: Let us try together. Take your time.
